name: Zooniverse
ageNote: All ages; under 16 should review the youth guidance with a parent
description: Help real scientists classify galaxies, tag wildlife photos, and transcribe historic records. Generates official volunteer certificates for service hours.

name: Smithsonian Digital Volunteers
description: Transcribe historical documents, field notes, and specimen labels for the world's largest museum complex.

name: NASA Citizen Science
ageNote: Many projects open to all ages
description: Hunt for exoplanets, classify clouds, and track landslides alongside NASA researchers.

name: iNaturalist
ageNote: 13+ for an account; younger with a parent-managed account
description: Photograph and identify plants and animals; your observations feed real biodiversity research.

name: Cards for Hospitalized Kids
description: Make and mail handmade cards to hospitalized children. Formally verifies service hours and is a President's Volunteer Service Award certifying nonprofit.

name: Letters Against Isolation
description: Write letters to isolated seniors in care facilities around the world.

name: Operation Gratitude
description: Write thank-you letters to troops, veterans, and first responders.

name: Love For Our Elders
description: Monthly letter-writing campaigns that bring joy to seniors.

name: TeensGive
description: High schoolers tutor children at Title 1 schools nationwide through one-on-one virtual sessions.

name: UPchieve
ageNote: Check current volunteer age requirement on their site
description: Free on-demand online tutoring in math and science for low-income students.

name: Learn To Be
ageNote: High school and up; verify on their site
description: Free 1-on-1 online tutoring for underserved K-12 students with flexible scheduling.

name: Best Buddies (e-Buddies & Virtual Chapters)
description: Build friendships with peers with intellectual and developmental disabilities through virtual chapters and pen pals.

name: Missing Maps
description: Trace roads and buildings on satellite imagery so aid organizations can reach communities in crisis.

name: Tarjimly
ageNote: Bilingual volunteers; check current age minimum
description: Provide on-demand translation for refugees and immigrants through an app, one session at a time.

name: TED Translators
description: Subtitle TED Talks in more than 100 languages so ideas can spread worldwide.

name: Translators Without Borders (CLEAR Global)
description: Translate crisis relief, health, and education materials for international organizations.

name: Distributed Proofreaders (Project Gutenberg)
description: Proofread scanned book pages to grow the world's largest free digital library.

name: LibriVox
description: Record audiobooks of public-domain books for free worldwide access.

name: Mapping Prejudice
description: Transcribe historical property deeds to uncover racial covenants and document social injustice.

name: Sierra Club Youth Campaigns
description: Join environmental justice campaigns, many with digital action components.

name: Humane Society Phone Banking
description: Make calls supporting animal-welfare legislative priorities from home.

name: American Red Cross Youth
ageNote: High school+ for clubs; some roles younger with an adult
description: Join or start a Red Cross Club supporting disaster relief and blood drive awareness, with some virtual roles.

name: DoSomething.org
description: Youth-designed campaigns for social good; complete actions and earn scholarship entries.

name: Youth Volunteer Corps
description: Team-based, supervised service projects across the U.S. and Canada designed specifically for youth.

name: Special Olympics
description: Coach, plan events, or play alongside athletes with intellectual disabilities through local chapters.

name: Girls on the Run
ageNote: Teen roles available; varies by council
description: Coach, cheer, host water stops, or run as a buddy supporting girls' confidence programs.

name: Be My Eyes
ageNote: Older teens; check current age minimum
description: Lend your eyes to blind and low-vision users through live video calls; bilingual volunteers especially needed.

name: UN Volunteers Online
description: Remote projects in human rights, disaster relief, and education worldwide.

name: ScholarMatch
description: Virtual college and career coaching for underserved youth.

name: Kids That Do Good
description: Directory built by teens for kids and families to plug into charities or start their own projects.
